notes: Machine-readable twin of docs/metrics.md (the normative dictionary). Pinned by the parity meta-tests in src/handlers/workflow.rs (scoreboard_tests) and src/docs_truth.rs. A formula change bumps scorer_version, this file, docs/metrics.md, and the gold-pack expectations in ONE PR. Units: rates are integer ten-thousandths (10000 = 100%); per-thousand densities are hundredths; times are seconds; money is cents. Benchmarks are reference points, never claims.

metrics.name: fcr_units
metrics.formula: runs_without_repeat / runs_scored over the scored cohort; a recurrence recorded inside the FCR window marks its predecessor not-first-contact-resolved
metrics.window: BRAIN_FCR_WINDOW_DAYS repeat-attribution window, default 7 days, closed boundary (age <= window counts)
metrics.inclusion: scored runs in the last-1000 cohort with a resolvable repeat-contact record or none
metrics.exclusion: recurrences older than the window never attribute back; unscored runs never enter
metrics.citation: SQM-class FCR repeat-window methodology; COPC R8.0 FCR discipline

metrics.name: repeat_contact_rate_units
metrics.formula: runs_with_repeat / runs_scored — complement of FCR
metrics.exclusion: deflection is never traded against this metric

metrics.name: correctness_units
metrics.formula: share of runs whose recorded findings contain no contradiction/incorrect marker
metrics.exclusion: contradiction-marked findings fail the run
metrics.citation: ISO 18295-1 process-clause posture; AI Act Art.12 traceability

metrics.name: override_rate_units
metrics.formula: share of workflow steps where human guidance overrode the engine's step output
metrics.inclusion: all derived StepRows of the cohort
metrics.exclusion: steps without a recorded expected/actual pair

metrics.name: gap_rate_units
metrics.formula: reserved: knowledge-gap rate from proposals, not runs alone; pinned to 0 in the run-derived scorer until the flywheel release emits it non-zero
metrics.inclusion: future: gap-class proposals over closed runs
metrics.exclusion: never inferred from run outcomes alone

metrics.name: abstention_rate_units
metrics.formula: share of steps where the engine abstained rather than guessed
metrics.exclusion: none — higher abstention is honesty, never penalized

metrics.name: guidance_acceptance_units
metrics.formula: accepted / (accepted + rejected); SCALE (10000) when none offered
metrics.exclusion: steps without offered guidance do not dilute the denominator

metrics.name: handoff_completeness_units
metrics.formula: share of runs reaching completed status with an I-PASS-complete handover record
metrics.exclusion: non-completed statuses; packets failing src/workflow/relay.rs::packet_missing
metrics.citation: I-PASS handover research; COPC service-level management

metrics.name: audit_green
metrics.formula: every scored run references at least one workflow audit row (fail-closed conjunction)
metrics.exclusion: absence never counts green; non-workflow audit kinds never satisfy
metrics.citation: AI Act Art.12 logging; SOC 2 readiness

metrics.name: escalation_honored_units
metrics.formula: share of runs where recorded escalation requests were honored; defaults true only when nothing was requested
metrics.inclusion: runs with an escalation_honored record or no escalation requested
metrics.exclusion: none

metrics.name: runs_scored
metrics.formula: count of runs in the scored cohort
metrics.inclusion: all runs in the window regardless of kind
metrics.exclusion: older runs beyond the cap

metrics.name: return_rate_units
metrics.formula: return_runs / runs_scored

metrics.name: warranty_claim_rate_units
metrics.formula: warranty_runs / runs_scored

metrics.name: ftfr_units
metrics.formula: repair-field runs with no repeat inside the FCR window / all repair-field runs; empty cohort scores 0
metrics.exclusion: absence of repair-field work is scored 0, never dressed up as perfection
metrics.citation: SQM-class repeat-window methodology; FSM FTFR benchmarks

metrics.name: refund_cycle_time_median_secs
metrics.formula: median(created_at → updated_at) over resolved return/warranty runs; 0 when none resolved
metrics.exclusion: unresolved runs

metrics.name: returnless_share_units
metrics.formula: returnless-disposed RETURN runs / all return runs; 0 when cohort empty
metrics.exclusion: returnless refunds always pair with fraud review (disposition ranking gates it)

metrics.name: aftersales_fraud_flag_rate_units
metrics.formula: fraud-flagged RETURN runs / all return runs; 0 when cohort empty
metrics.exclusion: signals inform HITL only — they never auto-deny

metrics.name: goodwill_total_cents_30d
metrics.formula: sum(amount_cents) over APPROVED remedy proposals in the trailing 30 days whose approval audit row verifies
metrics.inclusion: kind='complaint_remedy' status='approved' with verifiable audit linkage
metrics.exclusion: an unaudited remedy never aggregates (fail-closed)

metrics.name: goodwill_entries_30d
metrics.formula: count of audited approved remedies in the window
metrics.exclusion: same exclusions

metrics.name: goodwill_unaudited_excluded_30d
metrics.formula: approved remedies EXCLUDED for missing audit linkage
metrics.inclusion: approved remedies without verifiable audit rows — surfaced, never folded away

metrics.name: voc_contacts_total
metrics.formula: count of workflow runs — the contact volume the VoC ratio denominates
metrics.exclusion: CSAT/DSAT survey instruments stay CRM-side (ISO 10004)

metrics.name: voc_complaints_total
metrics.formula: count of runs with kind = 'complaint'

metrics.name: voc_complaints_per_thousand_contacts_units
metrics.formula: complaints * 100000 / max(contacts, 1); zero contacts score 0
metrics.inclusion: all complaint runs over all contacts
metrics.exclusion: survey-derived DSAT stays CRM-side

metrics.name: calibration_report_emitted
metrics.formula: true when THIS read crossed the weekly boundary and landed a machine-generated CalibrationRecord on the audit chain
metrics.exclusion: monthly human sign-off is a separate audited step

metrics.name: kcs_linkage_rate_units
metrics.formula: share of published knowledge linked from closed-run evidence
metrics.inclusion: published/governed articles linked from closed cases
metrics.exclusion: ungoverned drafts

metrics.name: searched_found_rate_units
metrics.formula: searched_found / (searched_found + searched_not_found) over case-article SIR events
metrics.inclusion: recorded search events ending found or not-found
metrics.exclusion: searches without a recorded SIR outcome

metrics.name: article_freshness_median_age_secs
metrics.formula: median age since last review across governed articles
metrics.exclusion: retired/unmanaged rows

metrics.name: self_service_deflection_units
metrics.formula: solved-proof feedback / total on-page KB feedback — INDICATIVE only
metrics.exclusion: never traded against repeat_contact_rate_units; governed by docs/kb-deflection.md

metrics.name: kb_feedback_total
metrics.formula: total on-page feedback events counted

metrics.name: kb_hot_topics
metrics.formula: top slugs by feedback count above KB_HOT_TOPIC_THRESHOLD
metrics.exclusion: below-threshold slugs stay out of the report

metrics.name: reask_rate
metrics.formula: re-ask events (case/reask) / closed cases
metrics.window: rolling; re-ask attribution within BRAIN_REASK_WINDOW_DAYS (default 3 days)
metrics.inclusion: three deterministic sources only: crm_merge (connector merge/reopen events), marked (operator reask note), derived (exact hashed-subject duplicate heuristic, HITL-gated as case_merge_suggested)
metrics.exclusion: no fuzzy matching; no surveys
metrics.citation: CXC customer-effort canon (effort-proxy dimension); Keystone v1.28.36

metrics.name: customer_effort_events
metrics.formula: repeats×2 + switches×1 + handovers×3 + re_asks×2 (frontdesk::effort_proxy) — deterministic CES proxy from lineage
metrics.inclusion: lineage-recorded repeats, channel switches, handovers, re-asks
metrics.exclusion: no survey instrument exists here (VoC surveys stay CRM-side per ISO 10004); lands as a scored dimension in the next scorer version with gold-set families extended — defined here so the formula is fixed before any code emits it
metrics.citation: CES lineage-derived twin; CXC customer-effort canon
